step_by_step_approach: Identify, for each customer, the rental that has the earliest payment date.
Find the rating category of the movie linked to that earliest rental.
Count the total number of rentals made by each customer.
Sum the monetary amounts of all payments made by each customer.
Calculate the number of subsequent rentals for each customer by subtracting one from their total rental count.
Link each customer to the rating category of their earliest rented movie.
Group customers according to those rating categories.
Compute, within each rating group, the average of the customers' total spent amounts.
Compute, within each rating group, the average of the customers' subsequent rental counts.
